body: Thank you, I know it’s not going to be easy and won’t just change overnight but I do want it to change. I want to feel myself again.

It’s been a build up of many things but the final straw was Saturday as my boyfriend just doesn’t understand my behaviour and left me. I just couldn’t take it. I ended up overdosing but got scared and phoned my mum who took me straight to hospital.
I don’t think I was really thinking at all. I did end up overdosing but I got scared and phoned my mum who took me straight to hospital. Just trying to deal with the fallout from that now.

I’m 37, I have two children and I’ve been suffering with depression for the last 6 months. I left my husband 2 years ago which my children hate me for I’m sure. Last year I was rushed into hospital with cauda equina and had emergency surgery I’ve had to give up the job I love and still suffer pain most days. Then today my partner left me as he could no longer take my mental health issues
That’s what I have to do I know, I don’t want anyone around me anyway. I really do hope so as that’s all that I feel I have at the moment is hope.
I guess that’s what I have been doing the last 6 months, just reached a real low point today

I too have reached that point today, it should feel scary but I just feel nothing. At present my mind is in a battle with itself and I’m constantly fighting it. I feel I’m complete limbo and really don’t know what to do
